Subject: Exec liaison roster & EB windowing for Helios MAP and close plan

Hi Robert —

Quick note to align on executive liaisons and preferred EB (executive brief) windows so we can finalize the Mutual Action Plan and lock the close timeline. High-level MAP milestones below (we'll share a tracked copy):

- Eval kickoff & infra onboarding: week of 5/3
- Tech deep-dive / integration sprint: 5/6–5/14
- Canary evaluation week (short POC): 5/17–5/21
- EB review (business + exec signoff): target week of 5/10–5/14
- Contract & procurement finish: target 5/31

Can you confirm: (1) who from your exec team should be listed as the primary liaison(s) on the MAP, and (2) two 60-min EB windows (PST) that work for them between 5/10–5/14 so we can lock calendars?

Attached is an exec liaison template you can fill quickly (exec_liaison_template.xlsx). I also dropped a living MAP draft into the shared Drive after we chat.

If it helps, suggested EB windows (PT):
- Tue 5/11: 13:00–14:00 or 14:30–15:30
- Wed 5/12: 09:00–10:00 or 10:30–11:30

Thanks — happy to adapt. Goal is to have a confirmed EB slot and attendee names by end of next week so Soojin and Karthik can prep the material.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear note. We're aligned on the approach. Please list the following as our executive touchpoints on the MAP:

- Robert Sloan — CEO (primary exec liaison)
- Maya Patel — Head of ML (technical exec)
- Anjali Rao — CFO (procurement/finance owner) — procurement@heliosai.com

For EB availability, the team can do two candidate windows (PT):
- Tue 5/11, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed 5/12, 10:30–11:30 PT

We also want Redwood to run a short canary evaluation week (5/17–5/21) focused on throughput and latency with our test corpus. Karthik can you confirm the minimal infra needs for the canary?

Attached: Helios_MAP_v2.xlsx (marketing + security addendum included). Please also share SOC2 snapshot and list of required evidence for procurement by 5/4 so Anjali can start the packet.

—Robert

Thanks Robert — good list. I pulled the MAP draft into the shared folder (link below) and mocked two EB agendas so the execs know what to expect. Short asks from my side to ensure the EB is productive:

1) Final attendee list (names + roles) by EOD Friday 4/30
2) Confirmation we can get SOC2 snapshot and any required compliance evidence by 5/4 (procurement requested)
3) Agree on the canary success criteria (throughput, 95th pct latency, and qualitative QA checks) — I listed defaults in the drive doc but will update with your inputs.

Proposed EB slot (locked for now): Tue 5/11, 13:30–14:30 PT — this gives us a 30-minute buffer between your preferred 13:00 slot and our slide handoff. If 13:30 is tight, we can pivot to Wed 5/12, 10:30–11:30 PT.

I also recommend two prep sessions (30m each):
- Internal/technical prep (Redwood + Helios infra leads) — week of 5/3
- Exec dry run (stakeholder walkthrough) — 2 days before EB

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/helios-map-2027

Robert/Maya/Anjali —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming we've locked Tue, 11 May 2027, 13:30–14:30 PT for the EB. Agenda will be: 15m business overview & success criteria, 25m technical highlights + canary outcomes, 15m Q&A/next steps.

Please reply-all with the final attendee roster (name, title, email) and confirm who will present from Helios for the business portion and who will join the technical deep dive.

Next steps: 
- Soojin & Karthik: finalize the EB slide deck and run the technical prep with Helios infra week of 5/3
- Redwood to start canary infra setup on 5/10 and run 5/17–5/21 per Helios test corpus
- Procurement: we'll push a SOC2 snapshot and collection checklist into the Drive today (DocuSign/contract will follow once EB confirms) — https://www.docusign.com/helios/MAP-signature
